personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Customized with Brand Gold and Admin Dark)
personality_one_liner: A premium, high-trust financial surface that pairs clinical stone-neutral brightness for consumers with deep, tactical darkness for admin operations.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for customer portal; tighter utility-first spacing for the admin portal.

do's: Use glass on bottom tabs over scrolling content.
Use glass for sticky instant buy/sell CTA bars at the bottom.
Use glass for floating modal overlays.
dont's: Avoid glass in the dense admin dark portal to maintain high contrast and utility.
Do not use on regular list items or data cards.

screens.name: Customer_Home
screens.purpose: Primary landing and quick purchase entry.

states.loading: Skeleton cards for ticker, hero banner, and category circles.
states.empty: Not applicable; defaults to 0 balance if new.
states.error: Failed to load live rates; Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky Header with tenant switch and logo. Top: Live Ticker Pill (with pulsing dot). Hero: Carousel of promo banners (dots indicator). Core Module: 'Instant Buy Gold' white card (price lock countdown, amount chips, large Proceed CTA). Horizontal scroll list: Jewellery categories (circular avatars). Bottom: Trending items.

screens.name: Customer_Vault
screens.purpose: Ledger, portfolio tracking, and quick actions.

states.loading: Skeleton for portfolio card and transaction rows.
states.empty: Illustration of empty vault + 'Start SIP' or 'Buy Gold' CTA.

screens.layout: Top: Large Portfolio Card (Grams, INR value, UnRealized Profit %). Middle: Quick action grid (Redeem / Sell / Invoice). Bottom: Ledger passbook section with sticky filter pills (All/Buy/Sell/SIP) and rows showing status badges.

screens.name: Staff_Admin_Dashboard

states.loading: Spinner centered on deep dark theme.

screens.layout: Dark theme forced (#0F172A). Top: Overview stat cards (Vault under custody, Counter sales). Middle: Live event stream ticker. Bottom: Navigation to specific queues (KYC, Pickups, POS).

screens.name: Staff_KYC_Queue
screens.layout: List of pending users. Tap opens a bottom sheet/modal containing Aadhaar/PAN image preview with Approve (Green) / Reject (Red) sticky bottom actions.

screens.name: Staff_Counter_POS
screens.layout: Single-column form. Customer Phone lookup -> Weight input -> Payment method toggles (Cash/Card/UPI) -> Large 'Generate Bill' CTA. Requires fast, dense, utility-first spacing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the two parallel themes: the Customer portal must use the Light tokens (surface #FFFFFF, surfaceSecondary #F8F9FA) with iOS-Native Clean layout rules, while the Staff Admin portal MUST be exclusively built using the Admin tokens (#0F172A, #1E293B, #111827) with dense utility layout.
Implement the 'Instant Buy Gold' widget on the Home screen as a high-prominence sticky/elevated card with a 5-minute lock countdown and fast denomination chips (+₹500, +₹1000).
Apply the user's specific 14px border radius (`md`) globally on all cards and bottom sheets.
Use Lucide icons throughout the app, maintaining a consistent weight of 500 max.
Ensure 'Proceed to Buy' and 'Generate Bill' CTAs are sticky at the bottom of their respective screens inside a KeyboardAvoidingView where necessary.
Admin navigation: Staff entry is via a separate mock PIN login. Implement a distinct bottom tab or drawer that only uses the dark tokens.
Do NOT use any blue, indigo, or purple. Stick entirely to the #D4AF37 gold palette and stone/slate neutrals.
Use proper gradient scrims (transparent to surfaceInverse) on any text placed over the promo banner carousel images.
